subject: English
passage: During the Renaissance, Isabella d'Este established herself as a prominent patron of the arts in Mantua. Collecting paintings and sculptures from master artists ______ of central significance to Isabella, who later became known as the "First Lady of the Renaissance" for her cultural contributions.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The singular verb "was" agrees in number with the singular subject "collecting." Gerunds such as "collecting" are always singular.
